prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a rear-end collision. The patient had 20 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1221; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with cervical strain. Over the course of care the patient attended 20 visits, combining manual therapy, range-of-motion exercises, and home stretching program. Treatment followed a typical course, with frequency reduced as symptoms gradually improved and the patient was discharged to self-directed exercise. Examination findings included reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness, which support a soft tissue injury, while neurological screening and strength testing remained within normal limits. The patient reports a remote, minor strain involving the same region that resolved completely without lasting limitation. At this time, it is not yet clear to what extent the present symptoms are attributable to this collision versus the prior strain, and further assessment may help clarify causation. Billing records reflect single entries for each service without duplicate or repeated charges.
